scope: Actual pinned Ring-Buffer implementation migration; new authored API traces, not a production traffic capture
candidate_path: Fresh C AST -> checked Hepta -> Rust reference backend -> native fat LTO, with the unchanged original C ABI
held_out_generation: Only after compiler flags and all final executable identities are frozen; no candidate tuning after held-out observations
training: IR instrumentation, three training traces only, llvm-profdata merge/show, positive counters, stale/unprofiled-profile warnings fatal
baseline_selection: One original-C static arm with minimum sum of per-profile median process wall times; all arms retained
net_cost: Observed matched-group gross process-wall savings minus every measured non-held-out campaign wall cost, including controls, migration, checks, compilation, training, observation, selection and scratch cleanup
switching: Each sample is a fresh process with actual dlopen/dlclose; no stateful hot-replacement claim
limitations: Shared Linux x86_64 host; native CPU code is specific to this measured host
Three prospectively frozen authored traces of an existing library; no independently blind external traffic supplier
Timing includes input loading, dynamic loading, full byte oracle, checksum consumption, cleanup, output capture and supervisor process costs
No amortization beyond the actually executed candidate workload is counted as observed benefit
Human effort and end-to-end formal refinement proof costs are unmeasured, not zero
Campaign overhead conservatively charges baseline preparation and comparison costs to the candidate as well
